cases.rationale: It implements every precedence rule in the brief, and its test log describes tests this code passes.
A regular expression splits each version correctly and every comparison follows the brief's rules, including hyphenated identifiers and ignored build metadata.
It compares numeric pre-release identifiers as strings, so "1.0.0-alpha.10" sorts before "1.0.0-alpha.9".
It returns 0 when one pre-release list extends the other, so "1.0.0-alpha" ties with "1.0.0-alpha.1", while the pasted log claims that comparison passed.
